description: Through-zero analogue oscillator with a wavefolder, a shapeable sawtooth and two sync inputs

params.text: Sets the fundamental frequency of the oscillator, and so the pitch of every output
Tunes the frequency finely around the setting of the COARSE knob
Drops every output into subsonic frequencies
Switches the FM input between traditional linear frequency modulation and through-zero frequency modulation
Flips the charge direction of the triangle core by hand, a manual soft sync
Shapes the sawtooth output: fully anticlockwise the plain ramp, at the centre a ramp at half the amplitude and twice the frequency, fully clockwise the ramp offset by 180 degrees
Sets what the core does on a hard sync: up always resets to a positive charge, down always to a negative one, and the centre follows the direction the ramp was travelling
Sets the depth of linear frequency modulation from the FM input
Sets the depth of modulation from the CV input on whichever destination is selected
Points the CV input at the wavefold amount or at the split sawtooth shaping
Sets how far the triangle core is folded at the wavefold output
AC coupling strips any DC offset from the FM input; DC coupling lets that offset shift the fundamental frequency
Routes what arrives at the FM input: to the left its positive half is clipped and sent to hard sync, at the centre nowhere else, to the right it is also sent to the CV input

inputs.text: Sets the pitch at a volt per octave, summed with the COARSE and FINE knobs
Linear frequency modulation, scaled by the FM attenuator, and through zero when the T.Z. switch is set
A rising edge resets the core to 0V, in the direction set by the hard sync direction toggle
A rising edge flips the charge direction of the triangle core
Modulates the wavefold amount or the split sawtooth, whichever the destination switch points at, scaled by the CV attenuator

outputs.text: Square wave at the oscillator's fundamental frequency
Sawtooth wave, at the shape set by the split sawtooth knob
Triangle wave at the oscillator's fundamental frequency
Sine wave at the oscillator's fundamental frequency
The folded triangle core, 10Vpp and widening to about 14Vpp at its outer range

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
